value.rationale: The all-subalgebra list was known, but classifying it modulo the natural coordinate-change group is a different complete invariant with individual orbit sizes. The arithmetic jump from 12 to 18 and 16+g exposes square classes in characteristic three and cube classes in characteristic two, including extension-degree parity, which aggregate counting cannot detect. This is a natural precise finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
